approval.note: yerel test: ifade çekim/biçim farkı (transcript'te çekimli geçiyor), yanlış pozitif

segments.text: Last month, my dad asked me to set up a smart speaker in his kitchen.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker's father asked for help installing a voice assistant device in his kitchen.
segments.turkishExplanation: Geçen ay babam, mutfağına akıllı bir hoparlör kurmamı istedi.

segments.text: I'd rather have spent my Saturday outdoors, but I agreed.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker would have preferred being outdoors on Saturday, but agreed to help anyway.
segments.turkishExplanation: Cumartesi günümü dışarıda geçirmeyi tercih ederdim ama kabul ettim.

segments.text: Within an hour, he had figured out how to play old jazz and check the weather.
segments.englishExplanation: In less than an hour, the father learned how to play jazz music and get weather reports.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir saat geçmeden eski caz müzikleri çalmayı ve hava durumuna bakmayı çözmüştü.

segments.text: Then he started asking it to order groceries.
segments.englishExplanation: After that, he started giving the speaker commands to order groceries.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sonra ona mutfak alışverişi siparişi vermesini söylemeye başladı.

segments.text: Dad, I'd rather you didn't connect it to your bank card yet, I said.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker advised their father not to link his credit or debit card to the device yet.
segments.turkishExplanation: "Baba, bunu henüz banka kartına bağlamamanı tercih ederim," dedim.

segments.text: He laughed and said he would rather trust a machine than queue at the supermarket.
segments.englishExplanation: The father laughed and said he prefers trusting automated technology over waiting in store lines.
segments.turkishExplanation: Güldü ve süpermarkette sıra beklemektense bir makineye güvenmeyi tercih edeceğini söyledi.

segments.text: I'd rather not admit it, but he's probably using it better than I do.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker reluctantly admits that their father is operating the device better than they do.
segments.turkishExplanation: İtiraf etmek istemiyorum ama muhtemelen onu benden daha iyi kullanıyor.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to express a preference or regret about a past action that did not happen.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir eyleme dair tercihi veya pişmanlığı ifade etmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I'd rather have stayed home yesterday than gone to the party.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Dün partiye gitmektense evde kalmış olmayı tercih ederdim.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to express how you would prefer someone else to behave or what you want them to do.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Başka birinin ne yapmasını veya yapmamasını istediğinizi belirtirken kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I'd rather you didn't share my phone number with anyone.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Telefon numaramı kimseyle paylaşmamanı tercih ederim.

quiz.question: In the video, what does the father prefer to do instead of queuing at the supermarket?

options.text: Trust a machine to order his groceries.
Ask his child to do his shopping every week.
Go to the market early in the morning.
Pay with cash instead of using a card.

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("would rather have + past participle") segment 2'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
Learning point ifadesi ("would rather + subject + past tense") segment 5'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
